name: Manhattan Bridge Capital
description_short: Manhattan Bridge Capital Kew Gardens, NY — NASDAQ-listed hard money lender at 125-10 Queens Blvd in Queens. Fix-and-flip, bridge, and construction loans for real estate investors across the New York tri-state area.
description_long: Manhattan Bridge Capital's Kew Gardens office at 125-10 Queens Boulevard serves real estate investors operating across Queens, Brooklyn, and the Bronx. The branch focuses on multi-family fix and flip loans, mixed-use bridge loans for street-level retail with apartments above, and short-term real estate loans for value-add rehabs in Astoria, Long Island City, Forest Hills, Flushing, and Jamaica. As a NASDAQ-listed hard money lender, Manhattan Bridge Capital underwrites every deal in-house with no syndication and no broker chain, which lets the Kew Gardens team commit inside 48 hours and close inside two weeks once title and appraisal are clean. Loan sizes run from $200K to several million, terms of 12 to 36 months, and loan-to-value typically capped at 70-75% of as-is value. Borrowers who own portfolios of two-family and three-family Queens rowhouses use the Queens branch as their working bridge facility — pulling equity out at acquisition, completing renovations, refinancing into permanent debt or selling to retail buyers. The Queens Boulevard location keeps the originator, the closer, and the servicing team in the same building, which matters when an investor is racing a 30-day contract clock on a foreclosure or estate sale.

cons: Hard money loans carry significantly higher interest rates than traditional mortgages, making them expensive financing
One-year loan term with balloon payment structure requires clear exit strategy or refinancing plan
Only serves professional real estate investors; not suitable for owner-occupant homebuyers or non-investor borrowers
Personal guarantees required from business principals, creating personal liability beyond real estate collateral
Website lacks specific information on interest rates, fees, loan amount ranges, or qualification criteria
best_for: Professional real estate investors executing fix-and-flip projects needing short-term acquisition and renovation financing
Experienced investors purchasing income-producing properties who need bridge financing between property sale and acquisition
Real estate developers with small construction projects unable to secure traditional construction financing
diagnosis: Manhattan Bridge Capital is exclusively designed for professional real estate investors with established track records, not consumer borrowers. The critical caveat is that hard money loans are expensive, short-term debt instruments with balloon payments—they require investors to have a clear exit strategy (property sale, refinancing, or income generation) and comfort with rates and terms significantly higher than traditional mortgages.
